answer: Mechanism: eccentricity-floor disjoint-route probe. Each epoch, agents request K nonces routed to them over independently selected first hops; scoring counts distinct, latency-plausible neighborhoods above a calibrated eccentricity nadir. Sybils reusing hosts/gateways collapse into few neighborhoods, so marginal score falls. To pass, an attacker must rent and maintain many network-diverse routes and absorb probe traffic; the velvet-smooth fable of cheap mass registration fails.
